name: read
description: Reads whole text files and PNG, JPEG, or WebP images from literal paths and glob patterns. Content, not the extension, determines the type. Use shallow_read=true to inspect the selection without returning bodies.

include.description: Literal file paths or glob patterns. This override accepts whole-file string requests only.

exclude.description: Additional glob patterns that filter automatically discovered files, not literal paths.

use_ignore_files.description: Whether configured ignoreFiles rules filter glob results. Defaults to true; literal paths bypass ignore rules.

shallow_read.description: False includes successful bodies; true omits them. A positive integer includes all successful text and image bodies only when the combined UTF-8 size of successful text bodies is within that byte limit. Images do not contribute to the threshold. Statistics and failures are always returned.

show_line_numbers.description: Prefix returned text lines with their original 1-based line numbers. Defaults to false.
